text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I told Fusaichi Pandora that a fan letter had arrived for her—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I feel so sluggish~~...
I don't feel like doing anyyything today~~~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I told you, I get it~!
I'm just not in the mood right now~...
choice_data_list: Make sure you read it properly.
Make sure you read it properly, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, alright.
I promise I'll read it. Just leave it over there~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while later, upon returning from running some errands,
I found Fusaichi Pandora intently reading a letter.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah♪ This person sent one before too!
They sent another one~♡
choice_data_list: Alright, looks like you're reading it properly.
Alright, you're reading it properly, I see.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Wah!? Geez, don't scare me like that!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, didn't I say I'd read it properly?
I was just feeling lazy back then, is all!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like there's any way I wouldn't read
letters from my fans, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Having fans is part of what makes me wanna do my best, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: So you'd better be grateful too, Trainer, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: All right, and what do we say?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Very well done!
You have to cherish your fans, okay~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While there were parts of her argument I wasn't entirely convinced by,
she hadn't said anything wrong. I resolved to continue
cherishing the fans moving forward.
